entities.name: Ikaros family zinc finger protein
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q6XDT6 from Myxine glutinosa; 505 residues and 100% query/reference coverage.
Contains six annotated C2H2 zinc-finger regions: four clustered near residues 18–128 and two near residues 448–500.
N-terminal and C-terminal C2H2 clusters are separated by a long low-complexity, serine/proline-rich region consistent with regulatory disorder.
Curated reference annotations place the protein in the nucleus and assign sequence-specific DNA-binding transcription-factor activity regulating RNA polymerase II transcription.
Sequence-derived properties: molecular mass approximately 55.4 kDa; theoretical pI approximately 8.23.

entities.name: RNA polymerase II transcription regulation
observations: The matched reviewed protein is annotated with regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and sequence-specific cis-regulatory DNA binding.

entities.name: C2H2 zinc-finger architecture
observations: Six C2H2 zinc fingers occur as two clusters: four N-terminal DNA-binding fingers and two C-terminal fingers likely involved in protein interactions or structural organization within the Ikaros family.
